comps.spec: Some have one, some don't: behind the screw-off tip on some (2.5A on one generic 1A charger; 15A in a Slime compressor's 12V plug), on the board on others (PureGear, Ugreen CD213); the Belkin teardown names none
comps.loc: Behind the screw-off tip, or on the board

comps.spec: Small power inductor of the step-down circuit (two on the Belkin F8J251, one per board on the Ugreen CD213): a spare for other small converters
Low-voltage electrolytic capacitors: 35V 10 µF in with 16V 470 µF and 6.3V 330 µF out on the Belkin, 35V 100 µF in and 16V 220 µF out on each Ugreen board — reuse only at or below the marked voltage
Small status LED beside the output ports (green on the Belkin F8J251, blue on the Ugreen CD213)
USB-C power delivery chip on USB-C models (Hynetek HUSB338L on the Belkin F8J251, HUSB339 on the Ugreen CD213) that agrees 9V or 12V with the phone; too small to reuse by hand
